newsitem.title: USA: Delaware Otsego says to be acquired.
newsitem.headline: Delaware Otsego says to be acquired.

text.p: Delaware Otsego Corp, parent of New York Susquehanna and Western Railway, said Monday that it agreed to an acquisition by a new company to be formed by Walter Rich, Delaware Otsego's president and chief executive officer.

The merger agreement calls for Delaware Otsego shareholders to receive $22 per share in cash for each Delaware Otsego common share, totaling about $55 million, a news release issued by Delaware Otsego said.
The transaction has been structured as a tender offer followed by a short-form merger and is expected to close in September 1997.
Following the acquisition, Delaware Otsego said it will continue to be headquartered in Cooperstown and Rich will control the company and continue as president and chief executive officer.
The transaction has been unanimously approved by Delaware Otsego's board.
